capabilities: Import PDFs into plugin-managed folders with SHA-256 duplicate detection
Search and filter papers by title, author, keyword, year, and reading status
Read, highlight, draw, and comment in a dedicated PDF workspace
Store annotations as editable JSON and generate an annotated.pdf copy
Analyze papers with AI and ask questions via @pp comments
extras: Local features are free and offline; AI features (Analyze, Reanalyze, @pp) consume credits billed before results finish and may consume credits on failed requests. PDFs over 30 pages cannot use AI features. The README links an external Editable Artifact Privacy Policy and warns against using AI features with confidential documents. Billing key is stored unencrypted in plugin settings; a free trial key is requested by email. The README's AI service URL appears blank/incomplete in the text.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage a library of academic PDFs with reading status, annotation storage, and annotated PDF generation.

requires.name: external AI processing service at editable.artifact-kit.com

summary: PDF paper library that imports, organizes, reads, and annotates academic papers in the vault, with optional paid AI analysis.
